reviews.author: Dominique

reviews.title: Crucial P310
reviews.comment:
PS5 Expansion:
Drive was instantly recognized on reboot.  Took about 10seconds to format the drive, and it migrated around 400gb's of game storage off the maxed out primary in under 90 seconds.  System test says 6330mbps read/write speed on it which I believe is limited only by the OEM processor.  Migrated games load much faster than on OEM setup and play noticeably smoother with ray-tracing enabled at 60fps.  No issues at all with this expansion drive and super happy with it right out of the box with no hassle involved.  I am not a tech guy looking for problems to nitpick, and this unit solved all of mine very neatly and added 2TB of storage in under 10min of setup time.  Nothing negative to say for someone who just wants his games to load quickly and run smoothly.
reviews.author: - KK

reviews.title: Heatsink for my laptop is a must
reviews.comment: Crucial is a trusted brand for me. It was very easy to install if you know what you're doing. I bought this for my ASUS A15 TUF laptop and it was compatible with it. The heat sink leaves a little bump but after screwing everything in, it doesn't look like an issue at all and fits nicely. Storage capacity I chose was 1tb and it works great for me. Great value for a trusted brand. I didnt5 notice any slow down, so it is fast in my opinion. I'd say just as quick as my internal drive.
reviews.author: Jay

reviews.title: A nice choice
reviews.comment: Easy installation, no issue when setting up on windows 11 and no heating issues with it.  The read and write speeds are great and imports and exports have been quick with no complications.

reviews.title: Was at a great value before price changed!
reviews.comment: For every pc the ssd is crucial... aside from that joke, in all seriousness this (when i bought it) was at a great value, cheap and nicely affordable.  the storage of mostly 1tb (because i use this as my main drive) is rather good for what i need it for.
